reissue.why: CLM-011. `extract_fullevent_fps.py` divided the extended-FPS cross section by a reco EFFICIENCY that `counts` had already been corrected for, because `MultiFold.RunStep2` assigns nu_k to truth-only-miss rows (omnifold.py:218-220). `extract_cross_section_nd`'s `completeness` argument means COVERAGE of the truth denominator by the OmniFold input (unfold_nd_omnifold_unbinned.py:992-999, of_in/denom_nd), and this extractor has no separate truth denominator -- the declared fiducial domain IS pass_truth -- so coverage is 1 BY CONSTRUCTION. The division is removed; `comp` is retained as a reporting mask only. THIS SETS THE PUBLISHED NORMALIZATION, which is why it re-issues the gate rather than riding a later commit.

measurement.why_niter3: At 48 seeds the two arms have essentially equal spread (sd ratio 1.036), so the advantage is entirely the 1.61 pp lower mean. niter=2's max sits 0.1428 pp below the immovable ceiling C AND grew +0.2291 pp going 16->48 seeds; niter=3's max did not move at all over the same expansion and sits 1.2441 pp below C. Realized exceedance of 0.05 is 6/48 vs 0/48 (Fisher exact p ~ 0.026, so the arms differ without any gaussian assumption).
measurement.corrected_earlier_claim: A 2026-08-05 19:25Z reading that the niter=3 sd 'grew 56%' was a small-sample artifact of differencing two 16-seed variance estimates: F=2.4498 on df (15,15), two-sided p=0.093, 95% CI for the sd ratio [0.925, 2.648], which contains 1.0 and contains the eventual 48-seed value 1.036. That reading briefly inverted the recommendation toward raising the tolerance to 0.055; it was not significant.
measurement.independent_review: agy (separate provider account, effort high) reproduced the F-test and interval, verified the operating point and both arms against the repo, and endorsed niter=3 + tol 0.05 on statistics, physics and tolerance governance.

The driver persists what argv did (train_fullevent_nominal.py:472-475) and freeze:seed_policy compares that against FROZEN, so job 56410365 would have trained 8 GPU-hours and been REJECTED. code_fixes_in_this_reissue.walltime_8h_to_12h: No wall time has ever been measured for this configuration (the nominal has never been trained), niter 2->3 raised the work ~50%, and this job runs TWO full trainings. The forcing consideration is the failure mode, not the estimate: an overrun during the floor repeat leaves NOMINAL_OUT present and FLOOR_OUT absent, whereupon a resubmit hits is_complete(args.out) (driver:349-352) -> die -> the floor repeat never runs. An overrun is unrecoverable without hand intervention. sbatch_powered_closure.sh:10 already uses 12h at qos=shared.
code_fixes_in_this_reissue.two_new_tests_that_catch_this_in_0.01s: freeze:seed_policy only fires on a FINISHED artifact. Added LauncherRestatesNoPolicy (launcher BYTES vs a retyped flag map, comment-aware so it tests behaviour not prose) and SeedPolicyHasOneSourceOfTruth (pins the retyped policy literal to the DRIVER's policy, closing the same eight-hours-late gap one file over). Both mutation-proved. Deliberately NOT FROZEN == NOMINAL_SEED_POLICY, which would be the audit-B2 constant-vs-constant antipattern. NOTE: the evidence was already on screen in a PASSING test -- test_selftest_config_gate_pass runs the launcher, whose echo printed niter=2 into captured stdout, asserting only that CONFIG GATE PASS appeared.
